feeds.title: ToughPigs - Muppet Fans Who Grew Up
feeds.description: A website for Muppet fans who grew up. Our mission is to provide a website and forum for biting satire, poignant observations, and general wittiness related to the Muppets, Sesame Street, Fraggle Rock, and all things connected to Jim Henson's life and legacy.

feeds.title: Muppet Stuff
feeds.description: This blog is devoted to merchandise featuring Jim Henson's Muppets. The name is a reference to the former 'Muppet Stuff' stores that operated from 1980-1993. Our mission, to paraphrase theirs, is 'Muppet Stuff A blog with nothing but!'

feeds.title: UNIMA-USA Blog
feeds.description: UNIMA-USA fulfills its mission in a range of formal and informal ways, but especially by encouraging and providing contacts to North American puppeteers traveling throughout the world and providing the same courtesy to international puppeteers traveling through North America.

feeds.title: Larrikin Puppets - Puppetry for all Occasions Blog
feeds.description: Based in Brisbane, Larrikin Puppets are unique party entertainers. Larger than life puppet characters bring a sense of fantasy and whimsy to all events.

feeds.title: San Francisco Bay Area Puppeteers Guild (SFBAPG)
feeds.description: Promoting the art of puppetry in the Bay Area.

feeds.title: Hazel Green Opera House
feeds.description: The opera house is where people and puppets come together for fun! Adults find our shows enjoyable, too. The opera house is home to 'The Fever River Puppeteers' who perform marionette and other puppet shows seasonally. We offer occasional puppetry workshops for children and adults.

feeds.title: Rimofacup
feeds.description: Performing objects of fascination and disquiet.

feeds.title: Amazing Clark Puppet Shows
feeds.description: The Amazing Clark Puppets presents exciting and fun puppet shows that are filled with music, and plenty of audience interaction for corporate events, libraries, community organizations, fairs, festivals, and family functions.

feeds.title: The Fairytale Puppet Theatre
feeds.description: The Fairytale Puppet Theatre is performing in and around Toronto, Ontario, Canada, since 1993.

feeds.title: PuppetVision Blog
feeds.description: The PuppetVision Blog originally launched in 2004 as a way to share all of the great puppetry work that was emerging on the web from artists all over the world. With the exception of a few hiatuses, PuppetVision has been continually updated with hundreds of examples of puppetry for over fifteen years, making it one of the oldest and most extensive puppetry web sites in the world.

feeds.title: Wit's End Puppets Blog
feeds.description: Wit's End Puppets is an innovative and experimental puppet theater in the national capital region, producing original work for adventurous audiences; collaborating with local partners to bring quality puppetry into contemporary performance; and educating children and adults about the craft of puppetry.

feeds.title: Enaids world
feeds.description: In this blog, I would like to show you here my work, these are fairy, elves children, elves babies and of course the 'fairy puppets that I create the last few years. Invent a new character takes a long time.

feeds.title: Starlite Puppets
feeds.description: Starlite Puppets is dedicated to sharing the art of storytelling with puppetry and live music. We believe that puppetry is for everyone--the young and the young at heart! We love to inspire magic, creativity, delight and wonder.

feeds.title: Muppets Henson
feeds.description: I am a lifelong Jim Henson/Muppet Fan, a Muppeteer who cherished every single moment I had working with the late great, Jim Henson and all his talented Muppet Performers.

feeds.title: Michelee Puppets Blog
feeds.description: MicheLee Puppets is the leader in educational puppetry theatre in Central Florida. They make learning with puppets fun and educational.

feeds.title: Moon and Sixpence Puppet Theatre Blog
feeds.description: The Moon and Sixpence Puppet Theatre is a marionette (string puppet) theatre. This kind of puppetry is more complex than glove or rod puppets and, because the puppeteers operate behind and above the marionettes, it requires a much bigger fit-up (staging).

feeds.title: Gravity From Above
feeds.description: Gravity From Above is a documentary on European puppetry.

feeds.title: Theatre of the Ancients
feeds.description: Theatre of the Ancients is a performing arts company specialising in puppetry, folk theatre, storytelling, ritual theatre and ceremony.

feeds.title: Young People's Puppet Theatre Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Young People's Puppet Theatre. We offer puppetry and puppetmaking projects for schools, teaching a range of artistic and dramatic skills, but also focussing on building teamwork and self-confidence within the group.

feeds.title: Puppet Place News
feeds.description: The official News Blog for Puppet Place, your hub for all things animated on stage and film in the UK. Find latest opinion, interviews and reviews from the worlds of puppetry and animation. We are dedicated to sharing our passion for puppetry and animation with the wider public and supporting artists and professionals working with these art forms. This blog is edited by Emma Windsor and Stephen Barrie Watters, Puppet Place News Editors.

feeds.title: Mikey's Art and Puppetry Blog
feeds.description: Hi! Welcome! I'm a very creative person who enjoys puppetry and drawing. As a puppeteer I've performed puppet shows in the Ottawa.Our goal at Artelle Puppets / Pythor Comics is to create entertaining art that is suitable for family audiences. Artelle Puppets: Our unique hand-made puppets are created from original designs. We sell them directly as vendors at various events throughout the Ottawa.

feeds.title: Scribbles and Shakespeare
feeds.description: Actor, writer and new puppeteer with a dance background, trained at East 15. Represented by Brynmoor Associates. Yorkshire lass emigrated to the South West. This blog will give some insight into my journey into the industry, along with tales of my writing endeavours.

feeds.title: Puppet Slamwich
feeds.description: Puppet Slamwich celebrates puppetry for adult audiences in all of its forms, from traditional to experimental, as well as related genres, such as vaudeville, cabaret, toy and Object Theater.

feeds.title: The Abstractions - The puppetry of Grant Harding Blog
feeds.description: My name is Grant Harding, and I'm a puppeteer and filmmaker in Ottawa, Ontario. I'm a graduate of Mermaid Theatre of Nova Scotia's Animation program and a member of the Ontario Puppetry Association.

feeds.title: Strings Attached Poppet Theatre
feeds.description: Since 1984 we tour throughout New Zealand and the rest of the world. Read about our stories, puppets and Norbert Hausberg who is the Solo marionette player behind it.

feeds.title: Strings & Things Puppet Theatre
feeds.description: Strings & Things Puppet Theatre is a Los Angeles based company that has been creating theater designs and construction for over two decades, bringing stories to life using a medley of styles and mediums: from elegant shadow puppets to life size mechanical rod and body puppets, creating a unique style of storytelling with a social conscience and a sense of humor for all ages.

feeds.title: Myra Su Puppetry and Theater Artist
feeds.description: Myra Su is a narrative artist specializing in storytelling through puppetry and live theater. Her primary medium is shadow puppetry but her work also includes bunraku and scroll puppetry.

feeds.title: Trompin' Manikins
feeds.description: Hillary Younglove is a local artist and art teacher whose growing interest in larger- than-life puppets led to her creation of Trompin' Manikins. This puppetry group has offered several local workshops that have delighted and engaged the community: bringing art, theater, and culture to people of all ages.

feeds.title: Little Angel Theatre: The Blog
feeds.description: London's only purpose-built puppet theatre with shows for all ages. Founded in 1962 by John Wright we create shows celebrating puppetry that also travel nationally and internationally as well as hosting visiting shows. Next to the theatre stands the workshop where all the puppets are lovingly made by our puppet makers for our shows.

feeds.title: Henson Blog
feeds.description: One Manly Muppet's Chronological Journey Thru Jim Henson's Career.

feeds.title: Olifantland
feeds.description: Barrydale Puppetry Performance Event 2016 created by the Handspring Puppet Trust and Net Vir Pret.

feeds.title: Beyond the Book Storytimes
feeds.description: I've been a children's librarian since 1986 and enjoy storytelling with books, puppets, props, and whatever else works.

feeds.title: In the Dark Again
feeds.description: Welcome to the first-ever comprehensive Chinese shadow pupptery site. This blog covers many of the endeavors I pursue in order to get closer to Chinese shadow puppetry, while also serving one of my main missions: to disseminate information about this incredible art form to the general public.

feeds.title: Antinomia
feeds.description: A studio blog of puppetry, performance, and visual arts.

feeds.title: Puppetry News Blog
feeds.description: The puppet is our metaphor, with the power to unite across cultural, language and social divides. Edited by Gary Friedman, based in Australia and working internationally producing workshops, theatre, film and webcasts from around the world.

feeds.title: Indonesian performance
feeds.description: A blog on the performing arts of Indonesia - performances, films and videos, meetings, noteworthy discussions and ongoing research into Indonesian performance from a transnational perspective by Matthew Isaac Cohen, Professor of International Theatre at Royal Holloway, University of London.

feeds.title: Puppet Muse
feeds.description: This blog is about my journey of creating and producing puppetry. Trials, Tribulations, Inspiration and Contemplation.

feeds.title: Chicago International Puppet Theater Festival
feeds.description: The Chicago International Puppet Theater Festival was founded to establish Chicago as a prominent center for the art of puppetry. This biennial Festival will present the highest quality local, national, and international puppet shows in venues across the city. Invited artists will lead workshops, public presentations and talks as an integral part of the Festival offerings.

feeds.title: The Golden Glue Gun
feeds.description: I love making puppets! What initially began as hobby has now consumed my life entirely. I have been building puppets for a couple of years now. In 2011, I interned under a former muppeteer named Michael Earl at Puppet School in Los Angeles, CA, and just this summer I published my first book on puppet building with two of my fellow puppet cohorts.

feeds.title: Pubbets Blog
feeds.description: Pubbets! features High-quality, hand-made, large-sized puppets and accessories supporting children's charities

feeds.title: James Kemp Puppets Blog
feeds.description: James Kemp is a puppet designer and builder at James Kemp Puppets. He is a custom puppet building work for television and stage shows.

feeds.title: Electric Mayhem Fan Blog
feeds.description: Posts involving your favourite muppet band members anything Animal, Floyd, Janice, Dr Teeth, Lips or Zoot related Snapchat.

feeds.title: The Company of Marionettes Puppet Shop
feeds.description: We are a UK based marionette puppet shop. Here you can buy hand made marionettes (string puppets) from a variety of talented marionette makers not only from the UK but from around the world. We make and source only the finest string puppets for our store.

feeds.title: We're Going To Go Back There Someday
feeds.description: A place to live, love, appreciate the Muppets, Fraggle Rock, Sesame Street, the Muppeteers, and Jim Henson.
